name: JoAi: Generate Element Variation

description.en: Generate a new variation of an existing element using AI, optionally guided by custom instructions.
description.de: Generiere mithilfe von KI eine neue Variation eines bestehenden Elements, optional gesteuert durch individuelle Anweisungen.
description.es: Generate a new variation of an existing element using AI, optionally guided by custom instructions.
description.fr: Generate a new variation of an existing element using AI, optionally guided by custom instructions.
description.ro: Generate a new variation of an existing element using AI, optionally guided by custom instructions.
description.it: Generate a new variation of an existing element using AI, optionally guided by custom instructions.

bot: Use this when the user wants an alternative version of an existing element. If the user refers to an element by name, list elements first to find the matching ID.

inputs.name: Element ID

description.en: The ID of the element to vary
description.de: Die ID des Elements, von dem eine Variation erstellt werden soll
description.es: The ID of the element to vary
description.fr: The ID of the element to vary
description.ro: The ID of the element to vary
description.it: The ID of the element to vary

inputs.bot: The element hash ID. If the user refers to an element by name, list elements first to find the matching ID.

inputs.name: Overrides

description.en: Definition overrides for this variation as JSON
description.de: Definitions-Überschreibungen für diese Variation als JSON
description.es: Sustituciones de la definición para esta variación como JSON
description.fr: Remplacements de définition pour cette variation au format JSON
description.ro: Suprascrieri ale definiției pentru această variație ca JSON
description.it: Sostituzioni della definizione per questa variazione come JSON

inputs.bot: Optional JSON object merged over the element spec for this variation only. For template elements, e.g. a different size or root tree.

inputs.name: Aspect Ratio

description.en: Aspect ratio for AI-generated variations (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3 or 3:4). Templates use their definition size.
description.de: Seitenverhältnis für KI-generierte Variationen (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3 oder 3:4). Vorlagen verwenden die Größe ihrer Definition.

inputs.bot: Optional aspect ratio for AI-generated variation images; ignored for templates.

inputs.name: Label
inputs.bot: Optional label, e.g. 'Outdoor scene' or 'Dark version'.

inputs.name: Mode

description.en: Render mode for template variations: light (default) or dark.
description.de: Render-Modus für Vorlagen-Variationen: light (Standard) oder dark.

inputs.bot: Optional, templates only. light | dark. Defaults to light.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.es: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.fr: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.ro: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.it: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
